streams.title: New characters
streams.summary: Nobuyuki Sanada is the first new character, and he's coming along nicely. There are 90+ more on the wishlist, so this is a long road.
streams.activity: Adding some extra physics to Nobuyuki's weapons.
streams.description: The big goal is bringing in characters from other Warriors games. Nobuyuki is the first one and is already playable in testing. The rest of the list is a wishlist for now, so the overall number stays low until more characters get going.

substreams.title: Nobuyuki Sanada
substreams.summary: Playable in testing, with his Samurai Warriors 4 look, moves, physics and a full set of weapons.
substreams.activity: Adding physics to the little pearl string on his Day & Night Blades.
substreams.description: Nobuyuki comes over from Samurai Warriors 4 and he's in a good place. You can pick him from his own Samurai 4 tab, his coat and ponytail move properly, and all six of his weapons are in, including a sakura Mythic weapon and a black and crimson X weapon. His hidden lower blade now comes out on the right attacks, just like in Samurai Warriors 4. Next up are his own character slot, his Gallery entry and a second outfit.

streams.title: Costume additions
streams.summary: 17 Samurai Warriors 4 outfits are working, and Sophitia's Soulcalibur outfit is nearly there.
streams.activity: Samurai Warriors 4 outfits are working, and Sophitia's outfit is close.
streams.description: Bringing outfits over from other games. Samurai Warriors 4 outfits are leading the way, with Sophitia from Soulcalibur close behind.

substreams.title: Sophitia outfits
substreams.summary: Her Broken Destiny outfit is built and the skirt moves nicely. The braid's movement is the last piece.
substreams.activity: The braid's movement is the last piece of her outfit.
substreams.description: Sophitia's Broken Destiny outfit from Soulcalibur is built and her skirt looks great in battle. Getting her braid to move properly is the last piece. A few Soulcalibur 2 outfits are on the list for later.

substreams.title: Samurai Warriors outfits
substreams.summary: 17 Samurai Warriors 4 outfits, physics and all, are working on their characters in testing.
substreams.activity: 17 outfits are working on their characters, physics included.
substreams.description: Samurai Warriors 4 outfits brought back onto the same characters in this game, cloth physics included. 17 are done and working.

substreams.summary: Outfits from Dynasty Warriors 8 XL and 9 are on the wishlist.
substreams.activity: Dynasty Warriors 8 XL and 9 outfits are on the wishlist.
substreams.description: Outfits for the Wei, Wu, Shu, Jin and Other characters. Nothing started yet.

substreams.activity: Origins outfits are a maybe for later.

streams.title: New character and costume slots
streams.summary: The Samurai 4 tab is in, and the first extra character slot is working. Extra outfit spaces come later.
streams.activity: The Samurai 4 tab is in, and the first extra character slot is working.
streams.description: Making room in the game for more: extra character slots, new tabs on the character select screen, and extra outfit spaces. This is separate from making the characters and outfits themselves.

substreams.title: Character slots
substreams.summary: The first brand new character slot is working.
substreams.activity: The first extra character slot is working.
substreams.description: The first brand new character slot shows up on the select screen and can be picked. Nobuyuki will move into it, which also brings Kojirō back to his usual place.

substreams.title: New character categories
substreams.summary: There's now a Samurai 4 tab on Character Select and Duel, with Nobuyuki in it.
substreams.activity: The Samurai 4 tab is in on Character Select and Duel.
substreams.description: New tabs on the character select screen, starting with Samurai 4 for Nobuyuki and whoever follows him. It's in on Character Select and Duel, with the Gallery next. Other tabs and their names aren't decided yet.

substreams.title: Costume slots
substreams.summary: Extra outfit spaces are planned so new outfits don't have to replace old ones.
substreams.activity: Extra outfit spaces are being planned.
substreams.description: Room for more outfits per character, so new ones can sit alongside the originals. The outfits themselves are tracked separately.

streams.title: Improved graphics
streams.summary: Smoother edges, stronger light shafts and sharper shadows are already working, with more on the way.
streams.activity: Crisper textures and quality presets are next.
streams.description: The game runs a custom graphics add-on. Smoother edges, stronger light shafts, sharper shadows and shadows from the scenery are all working. Crisper textures, less colour banding and simple quality presets are next.

streams.title: Menu improvements
streams.summary: Lots of menus have been tidied up and rescaled, and there are Xbox, PlayStation 5 and Switch 2 button prompts now.
streams.activity: Menus are being tidied up across the game.
streams.description: Menus across the game have been rescaled and tidied, most recently the Gallery. Button prompts for Xbox, PlayStation 5 and Switch 2 controllers have been added too.

screenshots.alt: The Battle Preparations menu with its updated layout
screenshots.caption: The reworked Battle Preparations menu.

streams.title: Larger battles
streams.summary: Battles can now hold up to 250 characters instead of 180, and soldiers no longer pop in at the edge of the screen.
streams.activity: Bigger battles of up to 250 characters are ready to try.
streams.description: The game normally caps a battle at 180 characters, so soldiers vanish and pop back in as others spawn. That cap is now 250, and a test battle hit 241 without any trouble. Characters are drawn further away too.

streams.title: Named officers become new characters
streams.summary: Battles already have named officers like Nobuyuki Sanada. The plan is to swap them for the new characters, with their own look and moves.
streams.activity: Working out how named officers are set up in the game's data.
streams.description: Many stages already feature named officers who aren't playable, such as Nobuyuki Sanada. The plan is to have them show up as the new playable characters instead, with their proper look and moveset, so meeting Nobuyuki in battle means meeting the real Nobuyuki. The game already does something similar for a few characters, which is a good sign. This follows on from the new character slots, so each new character can be used in battle once they have a slot of their own.

streams.title: New stages
streams.summary: New stages and stages from other games are planned. None picked yet.
streams.activity: New stages are on the plan.
streams.description: New stages and ones brought over from other games. The first picks haven't been made.

streams.activity: New enemy types are on the plan.
streams.description: Which enemies to add hasn't been decided yet.
